title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 7: Space Exploration Technologies Surges on Q2 Revenue Beat, Lockup Relief, and Terafab Update
excerpt: A confluence of forces paired to help send SPCX shares higher, today, Aug. 7, 2026.
content_html:
Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX), a rocket launch, spacecraft manufacturing, and satellite broadband services provider, closed at $133.11, up 15.83%. The stock rose after lockup fears eased, analysts turned more positive, and the company provided an update on its joint Terafab plans with Tesla. Trading volume reached 236.7M shares, coming in about 91% above its three-month average of 124.0M shares. Space Exploration Technologies IPO'd in 2026 and has fallen 17% since going public.

How the markets moved today

The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) rose 0.59% to 7,756, while the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) gained 1.28% to 26,686. Among aerospace and defense, launch services, and satellite communications peers, Rocket Lab (NASDAQ:RKLB) closed at $82.83, up 9.46%, and AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ:ASTS) closed at $71.94, up 6.80%, as launch and satellite-growth names stayed in focus.

What this means for investors

Much like yesterday, it's hard to pinpoint exactly what is sending SpaceX shares rocketing higher today, but it is likely a blend of:

  • time to digest the company's solid, first-ever earnings report

  • reduced fears from SpaceX's first lockup expiration

  • potential short-covering from nothing negative happening on lockup expiration day

  • an outline showing the $16.8 billion first phase of a Terafab semiconductor complex in Texas

  • news that SPCX's $60 billion deal for AI coding upstart Cursor could close as early as next week

Tons of moving parts to monitor for a company that has seemingly endless growth optionality, so this can be a bit overwhelming. That said, I'm happy to have a small position in the company and will likely make small purchases over time, but am not in a rush to do so -- exactly due to the volatility we have seen this week.

While I'm encouraged to see the stock's resilience this week, it nonetheless reinforces the notion that we need to focus on SpaceX's actual operations more than the circus going on around it, more than ever, if possible.

content_html_zh:
火箭发射、航天器制造和卫星宽带服务提供商太空探索技术公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）收盘于 133.11 美元，上涨 15.83%。 在禁售担忧缓解、分析师变得更加乐观以及该公司提供了与特斯拉联合 Terafab 计划的最新信息后，该股上涨。 交易量达到 2.367 亿股，比三个月平均水平 1.24 亿股高出约 91%。 Space Exploration Technologies 于 2026 年首次公开募股，自上市以来已下跌 17%。

今日市场走势如何

标准普尔 500 指数 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) 上涨 0.59%，至 7,756 点；纳斯达克综合指数 (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) 上涨 1.28%，至 26,686 点。 在航空航天和国防、发射服务和卫星通信同行中，Rocket Lab (纳斯达克股票代码：RKLB) 收于 82.83 美元，上涨 9.46%，AST SpaceMobile (纳斯达克股票代码：ASTS) 收于 71.94 美元，上涨 6.80%，因为发射和卫星增长公司仍然是焦点。

这对投资者意味着什么

就像昨天一样，很难准确地指出今天 SpaceX 股价飙升的具体原因，但很可能是以下因素的综合作用：

  • 是时候消化一下该公司有史以来第一份可靠的收益报告了
  • 减少了对 SpaceX 首次锁定期满的担忧
  • 锁定到期日没有发生任何负面事件时可能出现空头回补
  • 显示德克萨斯州 Terafab 半导体综合体一期工程耗资 168 亿美元的概要
  • 有消息称 SPCX 斥资 600 亿美元收购人工智能编码新贵 Cursor 的交易最早可能于下周完成

对于一家看似拥有无限增长选择的公司来说，需要监控大量的移动部件，因此这可能有点让人不知所措。 也就是说，我很高兴在公司拥有一个小职位，并且随着时间的推移可能会进行少量购买，但我并不急于这样做——正是由于我们本周看到的波动。

虽然我很高兴看到该股本周的反弹，但它仍然强化了这样一个观念：如果可能的话，我们需要比以往任何时候都更关注 SpaceX 的实际运营，而不是围绕它进行的马戏表演。
